name: FV_BC_CONTROL_SEGMENTS
description: This table contains the  budgetary control segments information defined for  the budgetary control types to create fusion budgetary control budget structure

columns.name: CONTROL_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for  the budgetary control type

columns.name: KEY_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this budget segment structure

columns.name: SEGMENT_NAME
columns.description: The general ledger keyflexfield segment name associated with this budgetary control stucture

columns.name: SUMMARY_CONTROL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the segment tree,tree label and tree version to be populated

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Display order of segments in control budget chart of account

columns.name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the general ledger accounting flexfield (GL_ACCT_FLEX) value.

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.description: The tree  code associated with this  budgetary control segment

columns.name: TREE_VERSION
columns.description: Tree version associated with  this  budgetary control  segment

columns.name: TREE_LABEL
columns.description: Tree Label  associated with  this  budgetary control  segment

columns.name: CTRL_FILTER_TREE_CODE
columns.description: Segment code for the hierachical structure used to derive budget execution control on budget transactions.

columns.name: CTRL_FILTER_TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Segment version identifier of the hierarchical struture used to derive budget execution control on budget transactions.

columns.name: CTRL_FILTER_SUMMARY_VALUE_ID
columns.description: Summary segment value from the derived budget execution control.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
